Meta.title: Soldé · Your invoices get paid
Meta.description: Soldé chases your clients for you, politely and at the right time, until they pay.

Hero.title: Your invoices get paid. You don't have to ask anymore.
Hero.lead: Soldé chases your clients for you, politely and at the right time, until they pay.
Hero.note: No credit card. Ready in 3 minutes.

Probleme.title: Chasing a client is the worst email of your week.
Probleme.lead: You rewrite the same sentence four times, you agonize over the tone, you send it on a Friday at 11 pm. Then you wait. Your client simply forgot.
brouillons: Hi, I'm just following up on…
Quick reminder about my invoice, in case…
I don't want to be pushy, but…

Fonctionnement.title: Set it up once. Soldé follows up until you're paid.

etape1.title: 1. Connect
etape1.text: Plug in your invoicing tool or import your invoices. Soldé spots the ones coming due.

etape2.title: 2. Pick the tone
etape2.text: Friendly at first, firmer later. You approve the templates, Soldé sends them.

etape3.title: 3. Get paid
etape3.text: As soon as the money lands, the reminders stop. You get a notification, that's it.

Simulateur.title: How much is sitting with your clients?
Simulateur.lead: Move the sliders. The math does itself, just like the reminders.
Simulateur.hypotheses: Assumptions: 4 invoices out of 10 paid late, 12 days late on average (3 with Soldé), 2 reminders per late invoice, 12 minutes per reminder.

Fonctionnalites.title: What Soldé does while you work.

canaux.title: Email and WhatsApp
canaux.text: Soldé uses the channel your client reads, at the time they read it.
canaux.whatsappTexte: Hi Claire, invoice 2026-041 (€2,480) is still open. Here's the link to pay it: solde.app/p/41

arret.title: It stops on its own
arret.text: Payment received, reminders cancelled. Nobody gets one reminder too many.

calendrier.title: Your schedule, your rules
calendrier.text: D+1, D+7, D+15 by default. Shift them, add more, pause a client.

tableau.title: Everything you're owed, on one screen
tableau.text: Who owes what, since when, and where each reminder stands.

paiement.title: Pay in one click
paiement.text: Every reminder includes a payment link, card or bank transfer.

Ton.title: Will my clients take it badly?
Ton.lead: No. You pick the tone of every reminder and see the message before it goes out. Try it:

cordial.subject: Quick reminder about invoice 2026-041
body: Hope all is well on your side. Invoice 2026-041 for €2,480.00 was due on September 12. You can pay it in one click just below.

neutre.subject: Invoice 2026-041 awaiting payment
body: Invoice 2026-041 for €2,480.00, due on September 12, hasn't been paid yet. The payment link is below.

ferme.subject: Invoice 2026-041: payment expected within 48 hours
body: Invoice 2026-041 for €2,480.00 is now 15 days overdue. Please settle it within 48 hours. Late payment penalties may apply, in line with our terms.

camille.texte: “My biggest client used to pay at 45 days. Now it's D+3, and they thank me for the reminder.”

mehdi.texte: “I haven't written ‘just following up on this’ since March. I'm doing great.”

julie.texte: “With four of us, everyone thought someone else had followed up. Now nobody does, and the invoices get paid.”

Formules.title: One flat price. Zero commission on your invoices.

studio.pour: For busy freelancers and teams of 2 to 5.

agence.note: based on the number of users
inclus: API access and a dedicated contact

accord.q: Does Soldé send messages without my approval?
accord.r: No. You choose the schedule and the tone, and you can preview every reminder. For a special client, pause them in one click.

paiement.q: How does Soldé know an invoice is paid?
paiement.r: Through your bank, read-only, or your invoicing tool. You can also mark an invoice as paid by hand. Reminders stop right away.

whatsapp.r: Only if you turn it on for a client who gave you their number. By default, Soldé follows up by email.

apres.r: Nothing, unless you pick a plan. We never asked for a card, so there's no surprise charge.

donnees.r: In Europe. You can export or delete it whenever you want, from your settings.
